ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   B. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   B. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   D. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   D. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.

   C. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
   D. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
